codeReview.summary: The 1,792-line repository.py monolith was cleanly split into five well-organized domain modules (repository_identity.py, repository_chat.py, repository_optimization.py, repository_memory.py, repository_jobs.py) with shared helpers extracted into repository_shared.py. All 38 public methods from the original FleetRepository are preserved via a backward-compatible multiple-inheritance facade in __init__.py. DTOs were co-located with their domains and types.py was converted to a re-export shim, preserving existing import paths. Zero dangling imports were found. All 19 DB integration tests, unit tests, UI tests, lint, and typecheck pass.

issues.description: The _coerce_enum helper introduced in repository_shared.py is not used in repository_optimization.py, while it is used in repository_chat.py, repository_jobs.py, and repository_memory.py. This is not a bug (the optimization repo passes enum values directly, consistent with the original code), but it is a minor inconsistency in application of the extracted helper.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The multiple-inheritance FleetRepository facade pattern is effective for backward compatibility but is not documented in AGENTS.md. Future workers might not know this pattern exists when making similar splits.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: __init__.py defines FleetRepository(IdentityRepository, ChatRepository, OptimizationRepository, MemoryRepository, JobsRepository)

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker skill file (backend-refactor) was not found at the expected path .factory/skills/backend-refactor/SKILL.md, but the worker transcript shows they successfully invoked it via the Skill tool. The skill procedure was followed correctly.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows 'Tool: Skill { skill: backend-refactor }' followed by systematic reading, implementation, and validation.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker correctly preserved the types.py module as a re-export shim rather than deleting it, which protected existing imports from ~15 files across api/ and runtime/ that import DTOs from fleet_rlm.integrations.database.types.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: rg 'from fleet_rlm.integrations.database.types import' src/ returns 15 matches across api/auth, api/routers, api/runtime_services, and runtime/agent/persistence.py

summary: Feature db-split-repository is fully implemented and verified.
